scripts.build: npm run build -w @eixoone/shared-contracts && npm run build -w @eixoone/api-node
scripts.deploy:web:staging: node scripts/assert-safe-deploy.mjs staging && firebase deploy --project eixoone-staging --only hosting
scripts.deploy:web:production: node scripts/assert-safe-deploy.mjs production && firebase deploy --project eixoone-prod --only hosting
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @eixoone/shared-contracts && npm run lint -w @eixoone/api-node
scripts.test:emulators: npm run test:emulators:rules && npm run test:emulators:flow
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @eixoone/shared-contracts && npm run typecheck -w @eixoone/api-node
scripts.test: npm run test -w @eixoone/shared-contracts && npm run test -w @eixoone/api-node
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && node scripts/validate-firebase-config.mjs
